_comment: What the APScheduler cron engine produced, captured 2026-09-06 from src/domains/scheduled_actions/schedule_helpers.py before it was replaced by src/core/recurrence. Same doctrine as ADR-245's golden_kwargs.json: the proof outlives the implementation. NEVER edit an existing entry - a difference is either a known defect of the cron (it skips the day after a midnight-offset transition) or a regression.
